summary: All five 'likely' diagnoses and the insect bite rule exist with sensible criteria and every check_for item is used. Most consequential: the PPE rule uses the HIV-specific concept though the page only advises an HIV test, and the red-box urgent-attention check (page 82) has no priority evaluation.
